snippet.title: 10 Minutes of New Zombutcher Gameplay
snippet.description:
Explore 10 minutes of new gameplay from Zombutcher — a unique meat shop simulator where you serve both human and monster customers.

By day, you run a butchery. By night… things get weird.

Manage your shop, process meat, and deal with unusual clients as the line between human and monster starts to blur.

Wishlist Zombutcher on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4039900/ZOMBUTCHER_Monster_Business_Simulator/

#Zombutcher #IndieGame #Simulation #HorrorGame #Gameplay
